# CareerOS patterns

> Self-contained recipes taken from CareerOS, a creator's studio app built with Claude. Each recipe has a working demo, framework-free code and ADAPT.md instructions an AI can follow to bring it into another app.

Start with AGENTS.md, then catalog.json.

## Recipes

- [YouTube homepage preview](recipes/youtube-homepage-preview/README.md): a thumbnail as a home-feed card, and in a full home-feed preview among other videos. Steps for an AI: [ADAPT.md](recipes/youtube-homepage-preview/ADAPT.md)

## Pathways

- [Video editing](pathways/video-editing/README.md): the whole Premiere Pro editing workflow, from script to export. Then read [josh-cut-pro/CLAUDE.md](pathways/video-editing/josh-cut-pro/CLAUDE.md).

## Skills

- [Video editing prep](skills/video-editing-prep/SKILL.md): script to animation deck and shot list.
